adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around the shown change). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code tries to add other hosts’ destination calendars via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped and never reach downstream calendar creation logic. This is a real behavioral defect directly visible in the diff.
